description: FRED ECIALLCIV: Employment Cost Index — Total compensation, All Civilian. Quarterly, SA, index Dec 2005 = 100. Measures employer labor costs (wages + benefits); the Fed's preferred wage-inflation gauge. Countercyclical prior: faster comp growth = wage-inflation pressure = risk-off.
